name: stat-block
title: Stat block
description: Numbers that say what the product does: Funnel Display figures over a line of DM Sans each, under a hairline or on the #262626 fill, four across.
use_for: A section of facts on a home, product or about page. Every figure is true and checkable.
never: Colored figures or icons beside them
More than four numbers in a row
source: Derived from the guidelines (voice: concrete numbers) and the card on Black; the figures in the example come from the assets' copy (four networks, a brand added in under a minute, unlimited seats, $10 for the first month)

elements.name: StatBlock

examples.name: Rule
examples.label: Under a hairline
examples.content:
<!-- The figures the assets state, each under a hairline. -->
<spyglass-stat-block heading="Every creative in one place." stats='[{"value":"4","label":"Networks in one index: Meta, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube."},{"value":"1 min","label":"To add any brand or creator."},{"value":"Unlimited","label":"Team seats on the Creator plan."},{"value":"$10","label":"For your first month, then $20/month."}]'></spyglass-stat-block>

examples.name: Cards
examples.label: On the card fill
examples.content:
<!-- An Acme team's numbers, on the card fill. -->
<spyglass-stat-block variant="card" stats='[{"value":"128","label":"Brands tracked"},{"value":"42","label":"Boards shared"},{"value":"9","label":"Alerts this week"},{"value":"12","label":"Seats in use"}]'></spyglass-stat-block>
